organization.name: Roundcube project, steward Nextcloud GmbH
organization.notes: 2005 project start, not steward company founding (Nextcloud 2016). Project organization and strategic/operational responsibilities transferred to Nextcloud in 2023; open-source contributor copyrights are not represented as corporate equity. Funding combines community contributions and commercial steward resources; equity investor list not applicable to project.

pricingTiers.name: Roundcube core
pricingTiers.notes: GPL core download; infrastructure, IMAP/SMTP mailbox service and optional extensions separate.
No public Most popular or Recommended plan designation found in the source inspected; no popularity inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Roundcube Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Closest organizational commercial offer; get sales quote. Core remains free.

pricingTiers.name: Roundcube Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Nextcloud vendor enterprise subscription; optional Dovecot/Stalwart mail-server and Mailvelope bundles priced separately by quote.

moats.claim: Broad IMAP adoption, familiar webmail interaction and plugin integrations create an ecosystem moat, though open protocols make substitution possible.

productReasons.claim: Responsive browser webmail exposes multiple sender identities, threaded messages and drag-and-drop organization.
Address-book groups and LDAP connectors fit organizations with shared directory contacts.
Plugin API and OpenPGP integration allow tailored workflows and encrypted mail handling.

sponsorship.notes: Nextcloud assumed project organization and operational responsibilities; commercial backing confirmed on Roundcube Enterprise page. Separate sponsor roster not found on About/support; steward fallback used.

requirements.notes: Apache, Lighttpd, nginx, IIS, Cherokee or Hiawatha supported.
Required PCRE, DOM, JSON, Session, Sockets, OpenSSL, Mbstring, Filter, Ctype, Intl, PDO driver. Version 1.7.5 composer constraint >=8.1 <8.6.
PDO driver and create-table permission required.
Embedded file database; writable database directory.
IMAP4rev1 mailbox access and SMTP delivery; can be external existing mail services.
Complete release bundles dependencies; source checkout needs dependency install/build tooling.

requirements.condition: LDAP directory, thumbnails or QR-code features
requirements.notes: Install only extensions matching optional features.

resources.notes: PHP process memory configuration requirement, not full-server RAM recommendation. No CPU/storage minimum verified; depends on users and mailbox backend.

selfHosting.notes: Version 1.7.5 stable confirmed on download page; deployment source is current official install documentation plus 1.7.5 composer.json. No Redis/queue/object store required by core path; mail transport separate.

options.name: Softaculous Roundcube auto installer
options.notes: Available through a hosting control panel with Softaculous; official Roundcube download page links it.

oneClickInstall.notes: Official download page explicitly links Softaculous/cPanel auto installers and Cloudron app store; Docker Compose examples are manual, not one-click. Provider availability and versions must be checked on target host.
